questions.q: In a certain code language, ‘YEAH’ is coded as ‘207’, ‘BULK’ is coded as ‘186’. What is the code for ‘CORD’ in that code language?
questions.s:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (Sum of the Opposite value of all letters) × 3 = Code of the word.

‘YEAH’ is coded as ‘207’.

'YEAH' opposite 'BVZS'

⇒ (2 + 22 + 26 + 19) × 3

⇒ 69 × 3 = 207.

‘BULK’ is coded as ‘186’.

'BULK' opposite 'YFOP'

⇒ (25 + 6 + 15 + 16) × 3

⇒ 62 × 3 = 186.

Similarly, for 'CORD'

'CORD' opposite 'XLIW'

⇒ (24 + 12 + 9 + 23) × 3

⇒ 68 × 3 = 204.

So, 'CORD' will be written as '204'.

Hence, the correct answer is "204".

questions.q: If BQQMF is written as APPLE, how is GRAPE written?
questions.s:
Decode the pattern: BQQMF → APPLE

B-1=A, Q-1=P, Q-1=P, M-1=L, F-1=E ✓ (each letter in the code is 1 step ahead of the actual letter)

Code GRAPE:

G-1=F, R-1=Q, A-1=Z (wraps around), P-1=O, E-1=D

GRAPE = FQZOD

In a certain code language, 'He is my nephew' is coded as 'Co Pv Zs Mn'. 'That is my car' is coded as 'Zs Pt Pv Ga'. 'He is your uncle' is coded as 'Co Pv Ex Yz'. What is the code for 'nephew' in this code language?

एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में, 'He is my nephew' को 'Co Pv Zs Mn' के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है। 'That is my car' को 'Zs Pt Pv Ga' के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है। 'He is your uncle' को 'Co Pv Ex Yz' के रूप में कोडित किया जाता है। समान कोड भाषा में 'nephew' का कोड क्या है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
'He is my nephew' is coded as 'Co Pv Zs Mn'.

'That is my car' is coded as 'Zs Pt Pv Ga'

'He is your uncle' is coded as 'Co Pv Ex Yz'

Code for 'is' is 'Pv'.

Code for my is 'Zs'.

Code for 'He' is 'Co'

Hence, code for 'nephew' will be 'Mn'.
